newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Forty Belgians detained in Goma - Belgian TV.
newsitem.headline: Forty Belgians detained in Goma - Belgian TV.

text.p: Rebel Tutsis holding the east Zairean town of Goma were detaining about forty Belgian nationals there, Belgian commerical television station VTM said on Thursday.

Foreign Minister Erik Derycke told VTM the Belgians were under no physical threat, but "limited in their freedom to move around", and that he regretted the expatriates had not heeded calls to leave the region.
Diplomatic contacts to solve the problem were proving difficult, he said.
VTM said the Belgians were able to leave the town if they handed over large sums of money and most of their possessions to the rebels.

Fighting raged around Goma for six hours on Thursday as the Tutsi rebels took on exiled Rwandan Hutu former soldiers and militiamen before the arrival of international troops, expected on the ground to begin a humanitarian mission within days.
